---
title: scale-colour-manual
subtitle: "Manual discrete colour scale: supply the colour array directly."
category: Scales
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Colours cycle through `values` in the order levels appear, unless
`limits` fixes the level order.

## Usage

```typst
scale-colour-manual(
  values: (),
  name: none,
  limits: none,
  labels: auto,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | `()` | Array of colours, one per level. |
| `name` | `none` | Legend title. Overrides any name set via [`labs`](../labs/labs.qmd) when both are present. |
| `limits` | `none` | Array of level names controlling order and inclusion, or `none`. |
| `labels` | `auto` | Array of legend labels aligned with `limits`, or `auto`. |

## Returns

Scale object consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/scale-colour-manual-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = (
  (x: 1, y: 2, sp: "a"),
  (x: 2, y: 4, sp: "b"),
  (x: 3, y: 3, sp: "c"),
)
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y", colour: "sp"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 3pt),),
  scales: (scale-colour-manual(values: (
    rgb("#1b9e77"), rgb("#d95f02"), rgb("#7570b3"),
  )),),
)
```
